one_liner: Indian markets closed mixed with Nifty up 0.23% and Sensex slightly down.

drivers.title: No Catalyst
drivers.detail: No identifiable catalyst for market movements.

drivers.title: FII Outflows
drivers.detail: FIIs were net sellers with Rs 3,208.76 crore outflows.

drivers.title: DII Inflows
drivers.detail: DIIs were net buyers with Rs 3,617.75 crore inflows.

flows_line: FIIs were net sellers with Rs 3,208.76 crore outflows; DIIs were net buyers with Rs 3,617.75 crore inflows.
watch_next: Watch for BOJ Policy Rate decision and ECB President Lagarde's speech tomorrow.
lesson_seeds: Nifty 50 rose 0.23% despite no clear catalyst.
Pharma sector led gains with a 1.66% rise.
FIIs continued to sell, impacting market sentiment.
DIIs provided support with significant buying.
